text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's Foreign Minister says Kuwait could consider reconciliation with Iraq only after it complies with Security Council resolutions related to the 1990-91 Gulf crisis.
- Deputy parliament speaker denies contacts with Iraq's parliament. A press report has said Egyptian MPs were trying to bring Kuwaiti and Iraqi deputies to hold reconciliation talks.
- Parliament to discuss unemployment on Tuesday.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index falls 18.5 points to 1872.9 on Monday.
- Chief of Commerce and Industry Chamber says no economic ties with Israel before an Arab-Israeli peace is achieved.
- Communications Ministry mulls launching a satellite. Estimated cost set at $700 million.
